intro: Deep within the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan, an injured goblin named Kernobee lies battered among troggs after being ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves. Rescuing him uncovers unsettling intelligence about Dark Iron involvement in subterranean drilling machinery, which must be relayed all the way to Booty Bay.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.
Get me out of here, friend!

Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, friend. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
